regressions_resolved_during_validation: Clap flattening initially reused bbox/resolution_m argument IDs; distinct tile_bbox/tile_resolution_m IDs fixed all eight affected parser tests.
The new NetCDF repeat test initially passed overwrite=true and expected skip; corrected it to use the raw-attached decoded download API with overwrite=false. All 13 NetCDF tests then passed.
limitations: New zoom levels have not been tested against live providers individually; existing online acceptance and terms remain unchanged.
Windy and BMKG remain raw-only and are not admitted for local scientific projection.
OpenSnow remains unavailable pending canonical raw and frame-time evidence.
Web Mercator does not cover the poles; tile intersection is not evidence of radar observation coverage.
Requests download complete intersecting tiles, so decoded native bounds may extend beyond the requested viewport.
Automatic reduction obeys the 64-tile cap; stricter configured pixel, byte, temporary-memory or request budgets may still reject the operation.

Wunderground remains discovery-only at its fixed zoom-1 plan: its adapter does not enable raw acquisition without a verified provider response contract, so viewport tile selection does not apply to it.
Automatic selection also keeps the mosaic within 15 Mpx so the raw preview memory cap accepts every plan the selector returns; an explicit zoom over that budget is refused.
A wrapped (west > east) viewport wider than 180 degrees is rejected as a probable west/east swap.
RainViewer geometry and numeric-decode online readback covers zoom 1 only; frames at other zooms carry offline-only evidence and provenance markers.
